name: calory-tracking
description: A complete, modern-themed calorie tracking application based on Indian foods using React.js and SQLite.

scripts.server: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); let c = fs.readFileSync('server.js', 'utf8'); fs.writeFileSync('server.js', c.split('5000').join('5081'));" && nodemon server.js
scripts.build: node -e "console.log('=== APP.JSX ==='); console.log(require('fs').readFileSync('src/App.jsx', 'utf8')); console.log('=== SERVER.JS ==='); console.log(require('fs').readFileSync('server.js', 'utf8'))" && node fix.js && vite build
scripts.start: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); let c = fs.readFileSync('server.js', 'utf8'); fs.writeFileSync('server.js', c.split('5000').join('5081'));" && node server.js
